proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1351 āryikā lists WPah. ijjī/ij mother and its addendum expressly gives Jaunsari iji and poetic ije. The surveyed iji/ijā forms fit that regional mother series, distinct from mā́tṛ and dāī. Exact survey form ižā is preserved.
